channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Ahead of US midterms, Trump signs executive order to expand access to tax-exempt diesel: What we know
item.description: US President Donald Trump has signed an executive order expanding access to tax-exempt diesel as record fuel prices pose a political risk ahead of the November midterm elections, which will determine control of Congress.

item.title: US-Iran war LIVE: Trump "personally" thinks Iran behind attack on Flydubai flight after Vance says US yet to find a link
item.description: US-Iran war news LIVE: US President Donald Trump on Monday said that he “personally” believes Iran was responsible for the terrorist attack carried out by an Omani co-pilot on a Flydubai flight travelling from Dubai to Tel Aviv last week, despite JD Vance stating that US is yet to find a link

item.title: Abandoning pet in Chennai can cost ₹10,000, ₹5,000 for no licence; vet explains why microchipping is beneficial
item.description: Starting from 1 October, pet parents may be fined ₹10,000 if their cat or dog is found abandoned in Chennai. &nbsp;The Greater Chennai Corporation (GCC) plans to track down owners of lost or abandoned pets by scanning their microchips, which is currently mandatory for all pets in the city.

item.title: Beyond assembly: how India’s next telecom PLI wants to build the supply chain from within
item.description: The existing telecom PLI scheme, launched in February 2021, incentivizes local production of network switches, transmission gear, and set-top boxes over a five-year period ending as late as FY27. However, the scheme has seen uneven adoption.

item.title: Caleb Flynn, ex-American Idol singer, sentenced to life without parole after being found guilty of wife Ashley’s murder
item.description: Former American Idol contestant and Ohio pastor Caleb Flynn has been sentenced to life without parole for murdering his wife, Ashley. Prosecutors said he staged a break-in after the February shooting and blamed an intruder.

item.title: Yemen Says It’s Retaken Mocha as Battle for Bab El-Mandeb Looms
item.description: Yemen’s armed forces wrested control of the Red Sea city of Mocha on Monday after battles with the Iran-backed Houthis, according to state-run Saba, which puts the internationally recognized government closer to taking over the vital Bab el-Mandeb Strait.

item.title: US DOJ moves to revoke citizenship of 40 naturalised Americans accused of hiding criminal pasts
item.description: The US Justice Department has filed denaturalisation cases against 40 naturalised citizens accused of concealing criminal records, immigration fraud or other material facts when seeking citizenship. The cases form the largest such filing period under the Trump administration.

item.title: Actor Robert Kelker-Kelley, known for ‘Days of Our Lives’, dies at 62
item.description: Days of Our Lives actor Robert Kelker-Kelly has died aged 62. The actor, best known for playing Bo Brady, died in Missouri on October 3, according to a medical examiner. His cause of death has not been disclosed.

item.title: Omani pilot used crash axe to stab Captain Smit Machchar during Flydubai flight —what is its purpose? Expert explains
item.description: A Flydubai co-pilot allegedly attacked Captain Smit Machchhar with a cockpit crash axe and attempted to take control of flight FZ1073 from Dubai to Tel Aviv. The aircraft later diverted to Saudi Arabia. What is the purpose of crash axe in cockpit? Aviation expert explains.

item.title: BA295 flight crisis nothing now: 5 British Airways emergencies from the past; crisis and survival stories
item.description: BA295 was not the first time British Airways encountered a crisis. The airline has experienced multiple emergencies in the past.

item.title: Delhi content creator, 23, reveals ₹1.12 lakh monthly income after quitting ₹60K job
item.description: The other five collaborations involved posts on her Instagram account and brought in a combined ₹97,000. Upasana, however, noted that some of the collaborations have not been published yet.

item.title: Delhi-based makeup artist's ₹4.5 lakh weekly earnings stun internet: ‘Thinking about burning off my 15 years of degrees’
item.description: According to Momina, she spent ‘countless days’ working on free collaborations to build her portfolio and demonstrate her skills.

item.title: Using AI too much? Doctor shares 5 warning signs to watch out for before it takes a toll on your mental health
item.description: AI usage can become a concern when it starts replacing even minor things that one should be doing by themselves. A doctor explained how it may impact your mental well-being in the long run. Take a look.

item.title: Fire breaks out near Ranbir Kapoor’s Ramayana set in Mumbai, no injuries reported as safety concerns arise
item.description: A minor fire broke out in a tent outside Prime Focus Studios in Mumbai, where Ranbir Kapoor-starrer Ramayana is being shot. FWICE president BN Tiwari confirmed no one was injured and said shooting resumed.

item.title: Nigeria Air Force plane crashes en route to Lagos, killing all 32 on board- What we know
item.description: A Nigerian Air Force ATR-42 crashed in Ondo state while flying from Benin City to Lagos, killing all 32 people aboard. An investigation is underway.

item.title: Earthquake Today: Magnitude 4.9 earthquake strikes Afghanistan
item.description: An earthquake of magnitude 4.9 on the Richter scale jolted Afghanistan in the early hours of Monday, the National Centre for Seismology (NCS) said.

item.title: Russia lab worker dies of 'severe pneumonia', sparking plague scare; dozens quarantined: What we know so far
item.description: The World Health Organisation said it was aware of reports that a laboratory worker in Irkutsk Oblast, in the Russian Federation, died of ‘severe pneumonia.’

item.title: Karoline Leavitt joins Fox News after stepping down from Trump's administration: Here's what we know
item.description: Karoline Leavitt announced her exit from White House after welcoming her second child. She served as the press secretary.

item.title: BA295 flight status: London-Chicago British Airways’ aircraft plunges 27,000 feet in 7 minutes; here’s what happened
item.description: British Airways flight BA295 returned to Heathrow due to a cabin pressurization issue, descending rapidly from 36,000 to 9,000 feet. Concerns arose over its landing weight, exceeding the maximum by 30 tonnes, complicating fuel management before landing.

item.title: Who is Rahul Vohra? From a ₹144 crore LinkedIn exit to a health crisis that changed his work-life balance
item.description: Rahul Vohra is an Indo-British entrepreneur and the founder of productivity-focused email startup Superhuman.

item.title: Maharashtra: FDA, led by IAS Tukaram Mundhe, suspends licence of 8 outlets; check the complete list
item.description: The FDA has intensified food safety inspections in Maharashtra during the festive season, leading to the suspension and cancellation of several food establishment licenses due to hygiene violations.&nbsp;

item.title: British Airways flight that declared emergency over Ireland had sounded 7700 alert - What is it? Explained
item.description: The aircraft, which had departed Heathrow's Terminal 5 at around 11.50 AM (local time), declared an emergency while flying over Ireland.

item.title: New GRAP Rules in Delhi; Restrictions in NCR October 2026: Petrol vs Diesel vs CNG vs EV — Know car ban guidelines here
item.description: The revised GRAP in Delhi-NCR enforces plying restrictions on BS-III petrol and BS-IV diesel vehicles, excluding BS-VI, CNG, and electric cars. Measures now include earlier implementation for interstate buses and expanded monitoring of construction sites to combat air pollution.

item.title: British Airways flight declares emergency over Ireland after steep 28,000-ft descent: What happened? Insider details
item.description: British Airways Flight BA295 from London to Chicago declared an emergency over Ireland after a rapid descent from cruising altitude to around 9,000 feet. The Boeing 777 later turned back towards Heathrow.&nbsp;

item.title: Indians favour two-wheelers, but buses and trains dominate overnight travel: NSO survey
item.description: First national travel survey maps how Indians move for work, education and longer journeys.

item.title: Chicago-bound British Airways flight declares emergency over Ireland after steep 28,000-ft descent: Report
item.description: British Airways flight from London to Chicago, declared an emergency as per reports. Flight BA295 made a steep descent and transmitted aviation emergency code 7700.

item.title: Meet Justices Sunita Agarwal, DK Upadhyay, Aparesh Singh: Centre notifies appointment of 3 judges to Supreme Court
item.description: The Centre appointed three High Court Chief Justices as Supreme Court judges: Justice Sunita Agarwal, Justice DK Upadhyay, and Justice Aparesh Kumar Singh. This follows a recommendation from the Supreme Court Collegium. The Supreme Court now has 37 judges, one short of its sanctioned strength of 38.

item.title: Strong, prosperous India good for world, says US economist Michael Greenstone
item.description: Greenstone highlights India's potential to positively influence global prosperity, challenging the view that BRICS could be a threat to the US. He advocates for consistent US trade policies, educational improvements, and climate awareness to ensure sustainable growth.

item.title: UP Rajya Sabha elections: BJP releases list of 8 candidates; Ministers Hardeep Puri, BL Verma dropped
item.description: The BJP has announced eight candidates for the Rajya Sabha elections in Uttar Pradesh, where polls will be held for 10 seats. Notably, several current members are not included. The Samajwadi Party also named two candidates. Nominations are due on October 6, and voting is on October 16.

item.title: State borrowing to rise 26% to ₹3.6 tn in Q3 under new issuance strategy: ICRA
item.description: 26 states and UTs have adopted the RBI's Benchmark Issuance Strategy (BIS), making up 77% of the total planned borrowing in Q3. The BIS was introduced on a pilot basis in Q1 FY27 and requires participating states to issue securities within specified maturity buckets, instead of random tenors.

item.title: Aadhaar name correction new rules 2026: Which document do you need for spelling mistake, marriage or major name change?
item.description: Under the revised rules, Aadhaar holders have to submit the prescribed supporting documents for their particular request. UIDAI will verify the authenticity of documents, affidavits and Gazette notifications submitted for the update.

item.title: Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor challenges UK police over Epstein-linked arrest | What we know
item.description: Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor, King Charles’ younger brother, is taking legal action to challenge his February arrest on suspicion of misconduct in public office.&nbsp;

item.title: How India is fortifying the ‘Chicken’s Neck’: Underground rail, military bunkers, Rafales and more
item.description: India is stepping up efforts to secure the strategically vital Siliguri Corridor, or ‘Chicken’s Neck’, with plans for underground military facilities, stronger air power and a 40-km underground railway link.

item.title: SC declines to suspend CEC Gyanesh Kumar, seeks response on poll body decisions
item.description: The Supreme Court bench said the modified Form 6, which is used for inclusion of names in the electoral list during the process of SIR, was not approved by the court.

item.title: ‘Why are you afraid of women?’ Rahul Gandhi trains guns on Amit Shah over alleged Delhi Police misconduct
item.description: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi alleged that women protesters and female journalists were mistreated during recent incidents in Delhi and demanded that CCTV footage from Saket police station be made public and action be taken against officers found responsible.
